detection-kind.description: Result shape reported by the tool, e.g. timeline, individual, cached or aggregate.

detection-time.description: Parsed detection/timeline time only when the source specifies a timezone and representable precision; not import time.

raw-result.description: Normalized JSON representation of the complete reported detection, retaining unmapped fields. Original bytes remain authoritative in the export attachment.

result-index.description: One-based result ordinal in the original export, excluding CSV headers and blank JSONL lines.

review-status.description: Review state of the imported match. An importer sets unreviewed and must not infer malicious activity.

rule-file.description: Source rule filename/path as reported; not read by the importer.

rule-id.description: Rule identifier provided by the detecting tool. This is not an event record identifier.

rule-source.description: Reported rule format or source, e.g. sigma or chainsaw.

rule-status.description: Rule maturity/status as reported, not an analyst verdict on the detection.

rule-title.description: Name or title of the matching rule.

severity.description: Reported rule severity, retaining the original label or abbreviation; not Windows event Level.

source-format.description: Source export encoding: json, jsonl, csv or hayabusa-json for the native pretty-printed object stream.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact source export bytes; not a hash of the EVTX file.

timestamp-raw.description: Original detection/timeline timestamp string without precision or timezone changes.

tool.description: Tool that emitted the detection, e.g. hayabusa or chainsaw.

tool-version.description: Tool version explicitly supplied with the import; not inferred from a rule status.

description: An unreviewed rule match reported by a Windows event-log analysis tool. Keep matched event records and any analyst-confirmed conclusion as separate linked objects.
name: windows-event-log-detection
